name: Fear-killer concoction
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 27
Price 50 gp; Weight —
Category Concoctions
Description
A favorite of Ustalavic alchemists, this pale sludge hampers your fear response, granting a +2 alchemical bonus on your saves against fear effects. The concoction’s necrotic components dull healing, however, causing you to regain 2 fewer hit points from healing effects (to a minimum of 1 point of healing per effect).
